title: Grade 12 Mathematics — Definite Integrals & Area Under Curves
description: Fundamental theorem of calculus, definite integral evaluation, area problems
subject: mathematics

questions.question: The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus states: ∫ₐᵇ f(x) dx = ?
options: F(b) − F(a) where F is any antiderivative of f
questions.explanation: FTC: ∫ₐᵇ f(x) dx = F(b) − F(a) where F'(x) = f(x). The definite integral equals the change in any antiderivative from a to b. This connects differentiation and integration.

questions.question: The area between curve y = f(x) and the x-axis from x=a to x=b is:
options: |∫ₐᵇ f(x) dx| (if function doesn't cross x-axis)
questions.explanation: Area = ∫ₐᵇ f(x) dx if f(x) ≥ 0. If f(x) < 0 in some region, use |∫| or split the integral. The integral can be negative if curve is below x-axis; area is always positive.

questions.question: Property: ∫ₐᵇ f(x) dx = ?
questions.explanation: ∫ₐᵇ f(x) dx = −∫ᵇₐ f(x) dx. Swapping limits changes the sign. Other properties: ∫ₐᵃ = 0; ∫ₐᶜ = ∫ₐᵇ + ∫ᵇᶜ.

questions.question: Evaluate: ∫₁² (3x² − 2x + 1) dx
questions.explanation: ∫(3x²−2x+1)dx = x³−x²+x. At x=2: 8−4+2=6. At x=1: 1−1+1=1. Answer = 6−1 = 5. Hmm, let me recalculate: [x³−x²+x]₁² = (8−4+2)−(1−1+1) = 6−1 = 5.

questions.question: Area enclosed between y = x² and y = x (they intersect at x=0 and x=1) is:
questions.explanation: For 0≤x≤1: x > x² (upper curve is y=x). Area = ∫₀¹(x − x²)dx = [x²/2 − x³/3]₀¹ = 1/2 − 1/3 = 1/6.

questions.question: ∫ₐᵇ c·f(x) dx = ? (c is a constant)
questions.explanation: Constant multiple rule: ∫ₐᵇ c·f(x) dx = c × ∫ₐᵇ f(x) dx. Constants can be pulled out of the integral.

questions.question: Area bounded by y = √x, x = 0, x = 4, and y = 0 is:
For even function f(−x) = f(x): ∫₋ₐᵃ f(x) dx = ?
questions.explanation: Even function symmetry: ∫₋ₐᵃ f(x)dx = 2∫₀ᵃ f(x)dx. Odd function: ∫₋ₐᵃ f(x)dx = 0. Examples: x² is even; x³ is odd.

questions.question: Evaluate: ∫₋ππ sin x dx
questions.explanation: sin x is an odd function (sin(−x) = −sin x). For odd function over symmetric interval: ∫₋ₐᵃ = 0. Therefore ∫₋ππ sin x dx = 0.

questions.question: Area of the circle x² + y² = r² using integration is:
questions.explanation: Area of circle = 4 × ∫₀ʳ √(r²−x²) dx = 4 × (πr²/4) = πr². Using the integral of semi-circle and multiplying by 4. This confirms the formula A = πr².

questions.question: The area between two curves y = f(x) and y = g(x) where f(x) ≥ g(x) for a ≤ x ≤ b is:
questions.explanation: Area between curves = ∫ₐᵇ [f(x) − g(x)] dx when f(x) ≥ g(x). This gives the area of the region sandwiched between the two curves.
